description: The shell carries no plugin permissions beyond core — keychain, storage, and networking all live in the sidecar (docs/13 §7). shell:allow-execute is the one deliberate, narrowly-scoped exception (docs/07 §2, Phase 2b): it authorizes exactly one command, sidecar-ollama-serve, bound below to the literal `ollama` binary — not an arbitrary-command permission. UNVERIFIED: this capability file, its scope object, and the matching `ollama-serve` shell command definition it implies have never been validated against `tauri build`'s schema in this environment (no Rust/Tauri toolchain here) — confirm the exact scope shape against the installed tauri-plugin-shell version's schema before trusting this narrows anything.
